description: This file provides an API wrapper module for frontend use, including functions for HTTP requests, user authentication via Supabase, and CRUD operations for profiles, tags, and recipes. It centralizes API interaction logic for a culinary-related web application.

methods.name: getApiBase()
methods.description: Determine backend base URL from environment variables, ensuring no trailing slash.

methods.name: http.request
methods.description: Make an HTTP request with fetch, supporting get/post/put/delete methods, with JSON handling and error management.

methods.name: http.get
methods.description: Wrapper for GET requests using http.request.

methods.name: http.post
methods.description: Wrapper for POST requests using http.request.

methods.name: http.put
methods.description: Wrapper for PUT requests using http.request.

methods.name: http.delete
methods.description: Wrapper for DELETE requests using http.request.

methods.name: authApi.getSession
methods.description: Retrieve the current user session from Supabase.

methods.name: authApi.login
methods.description: Authenticate user with email and password via Supabase.

methods.name: authApi.logout
methods.description: Log out the current user from Supabase.

methods.name: authApi.register
methods.description: Register a new user, optionally creating a profile, via Supabase.

methods.name: profileApi.getProfile
methods.description: Fetch profile data for a given user ID from the database.

methods.name: profileApi.updateProfile
methods.description: Update profile data for a specified user ID.

methods.name: tagsApi.listAll
methods.description: Retrieve all tags, ordered by name, from the database.

methods.name: recipesApi.list
methods.description: List recipes with optional pagination, search, and author filtering.

methods.name: recipesApi.getById
methods.description: Retrieve a specific recipe by ID.

methods.name: recipesApi.create
methods.description: Create a new recipe, transforming ingredients and instructions arrays into strings.

methods.name: recipesApi.update
methods.description: Update an existing recipe, handling array transformations for ingredients and instructions.

methods.name: recipesApi.remove
methods.description: Delete a recipe by ID.
